svg.title: If qR ≤1/2, summing the geometric series gives the sales bound 2HC, uniformly in x and in the lattice period. This counts every endpoint and its complete lookup halo before any geometric shortening. Summing over the finite route coordinates at fixed n, then over n, is justified by nonnegativity; finite partial sums obey the same bound. The localization and chart factors used in these estimates have exact identities worth recording. Let γa(u, e) = χinner(at, ∥ue∥), Γa(u, Y ) = Y e∈Y γa(u, e).
